The Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) is an online form designed to replace the traditional paper-based arrival card and facilitate the entry process for travelers to Thailand, regardless of their mode of transportation via land, air, or sea. This system aims to strengthen security measures, streamline immigration procedures, and support public health management, ensuring a seamless experience for international visitors.
All non-Thai nationals entering the Kingdom of Thailand are required to complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card online prior to entry.
Foreigners are required to submit their arrival card information 3 days in advance of their arrival date in Thailand.

3. Enter

- If

5. Repeat

To delete the traveler's information, click “ Delete This Traveler ”.

7. Enter
your email address to receive the Thailand Digital Arrival Card.

9. Download

main_topic.h_title: Step for ​Update the Thailand Arrival Card

primary_content.text:
1. Click
" Update Arrival Card " button.

2. Enter
the required information for search, including:

- TH
Digital Arrival Card No.

4. Confirm
the correction of the information and edit any details as necessary.

5. Review
your information. Please verify the accuracy of all information before
submitting the form. Use “Previous” to modify information or “Cancel” to exit
without saving.

6. Enter
your email address to receive the Thailand Digital Arrival Card.

7. Check
the box to agree to the Terms and Conditions, then click " Submit."

8. Download
the Thailand Digital Arrival Card. You can also download or print a copy from
the email address provided for the duration of your stay in Thailand.
- All details must be entered in English.
- For dropdown fields, you can type three characters of the desired information, and the system will automatically display relevant options for selection.
- Please recheck your information every time you retrieve data from the MRZ.
- Please note that the Thailand Digital Arrival Card is not visa.
- Group submission can include up to 10 entries per submission.
- Please note that you will not be able to update the following information:
1) Full Name (In Passport)
